subject: Apollo 11
hook: APOLLO 11 IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Apollo 11 wasn’t the only mission on the Moon that day – the Soviet Luna 15 probe crashed on the lunar surface while Armstrong and Aldrin were still walking there
angle_support: the Soviet Union, despite early leads in spaceflight, was unable to match the Saturn V rocket, and its uncrewed lunar probe Luna 15 crashed on the Moon on July 21, while Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin were still on the lunar surface
while Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin were still on the lunar surface, Luna 15 crashed on the Moon on July 21
title: Luna 15 Crashed While Apollo 11 Walked the Moon
description: While Armstrong and Aldrin were exploring the Sea of Tranquility, the Soviet Luna 15 probe attempted its own landing and crashed. The space race had two missions on the Moon the same day.
narration: APOLLO 11 IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You assume the Moon had just the two American astronauts that July day. In reality, a Soviet unmanned probe was also descending, crashing while they walked. The Luna 15 mission launched on July 13, entered lunar orbit on July 17, and on July 21, 1969 it attempted a landing. Its descent module slammed into the Sea of Tranquility while Armstrong and Aldrin were on the surface. Two nations raced the Moon, and only one crashed that day.
